title: Load Tender Form
subtitle: Load Tender: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Load Tender Form covers offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance. The transport planning coordinator records Load Tender activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Load Tender Form keeps Load Tender exceptions visible until the transport planning coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Load Tender Form at origin, destination, route, pickup window, delivery window, and equipment location. Document offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance identity before Load Tender begins. Compare offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance findings with stated Load Tender criteria; route unresolved Load Tender issues to authorized carrier-management reviewer. For Load Tender Form, confirm requirements for Load Tender. Ask authorized carrier-management reviewer to review Load Tender conditions beyond the transport planning coordinator's role.
